title: Gearbox
text: Ideal rotational gearbox, 4 inputs, 4 outputs, {Interpolation method} sets Method Flat; {Port Configuration} sets the configuration, {Efficiency factors} sets the configuration, {Output shaft rotates in same direction as input} sets the rotation, {Input ambient temperature} sets the create input port, {Input to output gear ratio, N} sets the ratio, {Input shaft inertia, J1} sets the inertia .01, {Output shaft inertia, J2} sets the inertia .01, {Input shaft damping, b1} sets the damping .001, {Output shaft damping, b2} sets the damping .001, {Input shaft initial velocity, w1_o} sets the initial velocity, {Constant efficiency factor, eta} sets the efficiency, {Efficiency lookup table, eta_tbl} sets the lookup table M -by- N -by, {Efficiency torque breakpoints, Trq_bpts} sets the torque breakpoints, {Efficiency speed breakpoints, omega_bpts} sets the speed breakpoints, {Efficiency temperature breakpoints, Temp_bpts} sets the temperature breakpoints and {Air temperature, Tair} sets the ambient air temperature. Values come from the instance.
